items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: I think the first impression any of us had of a saxophone came either from Weedhoff or from the Six Brown Brothers.

ctx.x: Was Weedhoff of any importance? Was it a saxophone player in that period?

You know, the saxophone at that point was really a quite new instrument. I mean, it wasn't recognized by legitimate musicians at all. And I think the first impression any of us had of a saxophone came either from Weedhoff or from the Six Brown Brothers.
